title: South Africa Public Holidays: Reconciliation & Heritage
author: PubHoliday Research Team
excerpt: South Africa has two holidays that turn reflection into action: Reconciliation Day and Heritage Day. Here is what they mean and why they matter.
content:
South Africa's public holiday calendar includes two dates that stand out for their focus on national identity rather than religious observance: Reconciliation Day on 16 December and Heritage Day on 24 September. Both emerged from the post-apartheid nation-building project, and both invite South Africans — and visitors — to think about what the country is and what it aspires to be.

Reconciliation Day (16 December)

Formerly known as the Day of the Covenant, Reconciliation Day replaced the old holiday in 1995 as part of the Truth and Reconciliation Commission's broader effort to reframe South African memory. The date sits inside the period historically marked by Afrikaners as the Day of the Vow, which commemorates the 1838 Battle of Blood River. Rather than erasing that history, the new holiday invites all South Africans to reflect on division and choose dialogue instead.

For many, the day is spent with family, church services, or quiet conversation about the country's past. For others, it is an opportunity to visit memorials, read about the TRC, or simply pause amid year-end festivities. The dual meaning is intentional: the same date holds different weight for different communities, and the holiday asks them to share the same calendar without requiring agreement on every detail.

Heritage Day (24 September)

Heritage Day is perhaps the more widely celebrated of the two. Known informally as the Braai Day, it has become a cultural moment where South Africans gather around a grill, share food, and celebrate the diversity of the nation's traditions. The official theme is heritage — language, music, clothing, cuisine, and the many stories that make up South African identity.

The braai tradition is more than a party. It is a social equalizer. On Heritage Day, people of different backgrounds stand side by side at the same grill, and the ritual of cooking together becomes a metaphor for the country's broader project of inclusion. Schools hold heritage presentations. Communities organize festivals. Radio and television feature programs about regional history and notable South Africans.

Why These Holidays Matter for Visitors

Travelers who visit South Africa around these dates will notice a different atmosphere. Businesses may be closed on Reconciliation Day. Heritage Day falls on a Saturday in 2026, making it a long weekend for many. Local events are more visible, and there is a sense of national conversation that is less present on ordinary days.

  1. Respect the dual meaning — Reconciliation Day is solemn for some and celebratory for others; both responses are valid.
  2. Join a braai on Heritage Day — It is one of the most accessible ways to experience South African social culture.
  3. Learn the history — Understanding the TRC and the transition from apartheid adds depth to both holidays.
  4. Support local events — Heritage festivals and community gatherings are often free and open to the public.

title: 南非公共假日：和解日与遗产日
author: PubHoliday Research Team
excerpt: 南非有两个以反思和行动为核心的公共假日：和解日与遗产日。了解它们的含义与重要性。
content:
南非的公共假日日历中有两个日子因其聚焦于国家认同而非宗教纪念而格外突出：12月16日的和解日与9月24日的遗产日。这两个节日都诞生于后种族隔离时代的国家建设项目，它们邀请南非人——以及访客——思考这个国家是什么，以及它向往成为什么。

和解日（12月16日）

和解日的前身是盟约日，于1995年取代旧假日，成为真相与和解委员会更广泛的反思项目的一部分。这个日期位于阿非利卡人历史上称为"誓言日"的时段内，纪念1838年的血河战役。新假日并没有抹去这段历史，而是邀请所有南非人反思分裂，并选择对话而非仇恨。

对许多人来说，这一天与家人共度、参加教会礼拜，或安静地探讨国家的过去。对另一些人来说，它是参观纪念馆、阅读真相与和解委员会资料，或在年末节庆中暂停思考的机会。这种双重意义是有意为之的：同一日期对不同社区具有不同分量，假日要求他们共享同一个日历，而不必在所有细节上达成一致。

遗产日（9月24日）

遗产日是两个节日中庆祝更为广泛的一个。 informal 被称为"烧烤日"，它已成为南非人聚集在烤架旁、分享食物、庆祝国家多样性的文化时刻。官方主题是遗产——语言、音乐、服饰、美食，以及构成南非身份的众多故事。

烧烤传统不仅仅是一场聚会。它是一种社会平等器。在遗产日，不同背景的人站在同一个烤架旁，烹饪的仪式成为国家包容性项目的隐喻。学校举办遗产展示，社区组织节庆活动，广播电视播放关于区域历史和著名南非人的节目。

为什么这些假日对访客很重要

在这两个日期前后访问南非的旅行者会注意到不同的氛围。和解日当天商家可能会关门。2026年的遗产日落在星期六，对许多人来说是长周末。本地活动更加可见，平日少有的全国性对话氛围也会浮现。

  1. 尊重双重意义 — 和解日对某些人来说是庄重的，对另一些人来说是庆祝的；两种反应都有效。
  2. 在遗产日参加烧烤 — 这是体验南非社会文化最便捷的方式之一。
  3. 了解历史 — 理解真相与和解委员会和种族隔离后的转型，能为两个节日增添深度。
  4. 支持本地活动 — 遗产节庆和社区聚会通常是免费开放的。

title: Singapore Public Holidays: A Multicultural Stack
author: Wei Ling Tan
excerpt: Singapore's public holiday calendar reflects its multicultural society with holidays from Buddhist, Christian, Islamic, Hindu, and secular traditions.
content:
Singapore's public holiday calendar is a fascinating study in multicultural coexistence. Unlike many countries that follow a single religious or cultural calendar, Singapore stacks holidays from multiple traditions — Buddhist, Christian, Islamic, Hindu, and secular — creating a year-round rhythm that reflects the nation's diverse population.

The Holiday Stack

Singapore recognizes 11-12 public holidays annually, with the exact number depending on whether certain festivals fall on weekends. The holidays rotate across different religious calendars, ensuring no single group dominates the schedule:

  • Chinese festivals: Chinese New Year (2 days), Hari Raya Puasa (Eid al-Fitr), Hari Raya Haji (Eid al-Adha)
  • Buddhist: Vesak Day
  • Christian: Christmas Day, Good Friday
  • Hindu: Deepavali
  • Secular: National Day (Aug 9), Labour Day (May 1)

2026 Holiday Schedule

Looking ahead to 2026, Singapore's public holidays include:

  • Jan 1: New Year's Day
  • Jan 29-30: Chinese New Year
  • Apr 2: Good Friday
  • Apr 13: Vesak Day
  • Apr 18: Hari Raya Puasa
  • May 1: Labour Day
  • May 26: Hari Raya Haji
  • Aug 9: National Day
  • Oct 20: Deepavali
  • Dec 25: Christmas Day

Cultural Significance

Singapore's holiday stacking isn't just about accommodation — it's about celebration. The multi-faith calendar creates natural opportunities for cross-cultural exchange. It's common to see Muslim colleagues inviting non-Muslim coworkers to open houses during Hari Raya, or Buddhist temples opening their doors during Vesak for community meals.

This "stacked" approach to public holidays reflects Singapore's broader philosophy: diversity isn't something to manage, but something to celebrate.

title: 新加坡公共假日：多元文化的叠加
author: Wei Ling Tan
excerpt: 新加坡的公共假日日历是多民族共存的有趣研究，从多个传统中叠加假日——佛教、基督教、伊斯兰教、印度教和世俗。
content:
新加坡的公共假日日历是多民族共存的有趣研究。与遵循单一宗教或文化日历的许多国家不同，新加坡从多个传统中叠加假日——佛教、基督教、伊斯兰教、印度教和世俗——创造了一种反映国家多样化人口的全年节奏。

假日叠加

新加坡每年承认11-12个公共假日，确切数量取决于某些节日是否落在周末。假日在不同宗教日历之间轮换，确保没有单一群体主导时间表：

  • 中国节日：春节（2天）、开斋节、哈芝节
  • 佛教：卫塞节
  • 基督教：圣诞节、耶稣受难日
  • 印度教：屠妖节
  • 世俗：国庆节（8月9日）、劳动节（5月1日）

2026年假日日程

展望2026年，新加坡的公共假日包括：

  • 1月1日：元旦
  • 1月29-30日：春节
  • 4月2日：耶稣受难日
  • 4月13日：卫塞节
  • 4月18日：开斋节
  • 5月1日：劳动节
  • 5月26日：哈芝节
  • 8月9日：国庆节
  • 10月20日：屠妖节
  • 12月25日：圣诞节

文化意义

新加坡的假日叠加不仅仅是适应——更是庆祝。多信仰日历创造了跨文化交流的自然机会。经常可以看到穆斯林同事在开斋节期间邀请非穆斯林同事参加开斋宴会，或佛教寺庙在卫塞节期间开放门户进行社区餐会。

这种对公共假日的"叠加"方式反映了新加坡更广泛的哲学：多样性不是需要管理的问题，而是值得庆祝的事情。

title: UAE Public Holidays: Floating Eid Dates
author: Admin
excerpt: UAE Public Holidays: Floating Eid Dates
content:
Main Keyword: uae public holidays

Long-tail Keywords: uae holidays 2026, dubai public holidays, eid holidays uae

Date: 2026-08-31

---

The United Arab Emirates follows a hybrid calendar for public holidays: secular dates are fixed, but Islamic holidays float based on lunar observations. This creates a unique scheduling challenge — Eid al-Fitr and Eid al-Adha dates can shift by a day depending on moon sighting announcements across the Gulf region.

2026 UAE Holiday Calendar

The UAE recognizes 10+ public holidays annually. Here's what's confirmed for 2026:

| Date | Holiday | Notes |

|------|---------|-------|

| Jan 1 | New Year's Day | Secular, fixed |

| Feb 18 | Eid al-Fitr | Floating — subject to moon sighting |

| Feb 19 | Eid al-Fitr Holiday | Floating |

| Mar 30 | Eid al-Adha | Floating — subject to moon sighting |

| Mar 31 | Eid al-Adha Holiday | Floating |

| Aug 9 | Eid穆巴拉克 | Secular holiday |

| Nov 25 | UAE National Day | Fixed, 2 days off |

| Dec 25 | Christmas Day | Recognized but not widely celebrated |

Note: Some dates are estimates based on lunar calendar calculations. The UAE officially announces Eid dates 1-2 days in advance.

The Floating Holiday Challenge

For expats and businesses in the UAE, floating holidays create planning complexity:

  • **Work schedules:** Offices may close unexpectedly if Eid is declared early
  • **Travel bookings:** Flight and hotel prices fluctuate around Eid periods
  • **Service appointments:** Banks, government offices, and many businesses close for 2-3 days during Eid

    • Tips for Navigating UAE Public Holidays

    1. Follow official announcements: The UAE Supreme Committee announces Eid dates via state media. Check the official UAE government portal or follow local news.

    2. Plan around uncertainty: If you have important deadlines during Ramadan or Eid season, build in buffer days. The moon sighting can shift celebrations by 24-48 hours.

    3. Understand the weekend: The UAE weekend is Saturday-Sunday (changed from Friday-Saturday in 2022). This affects how holidays stack with weekends.

    4. Respect local customs: During Ramadan, eating, drinking, and smoking in public during daylight hours is frowned upon. Many restaurants close or operate with reduced hours.

    Why This Matters for Expats

    The UAE is home to over 90% expatriates. Understanding the holiday calendar isn't just about time off — it's about cultural participation. Joining Eid celebrations with colleagues, understanding when schools close, and knowing which services will be unavailable are essential for daily life.

    For visitors, the floating holidays mean trip timing matters. Tourist sites are beautiful during Eid (decorated, festive atmosphere) but crowded and expensive. The week before Ramadan is actually a great time to visit — fewer crowds, lower prices, and you'll experience the lead-up to the holy month.

    FAQ

    Q: How far in advance are UAE Eid dates announced?

    A: Usually 1-2 days before, based on actual moon sighting. Sometimes the Supreme Committee announces a tentative date a week ahead, but the official date comes last minute.

    Q: Do all UAE emirates follow the same holiday schedule?

    A: Yes, the federal government sets unified public holidays. However, some local observances may vary by emirate.

    Q: Is Christmas Day a public holiday in the UAE?

    A: Christmas Day (Dec 25) is recognized, and many Christian expats get the day off. However, it's not as universally observed as in Western countries.

    Q: What happens if Eid falls on a weekend?

    A: The UAE government typically announces a compensatory day off. For example, if Eid al-Fitr falls on a Saturday, Monday might be a holiday.

2026 年阿联酋假日日历

阿联酋每年认可 10+ 个公共假日。以下是 2026 年已确认的日期：

| 日期 | 假日 | 备注 |

浮动假日的挑战

  • **旅行预订：** 开斋节期间机票和酒店价格波动
  • **服务预约：** 银行、政府机构和许多企业在开斋节关闭 2-3 天

    • 应对阿联酋公共假日的提示

    1. 关注官方公告： 阿联酋最高委员会通过国家媒体宣布开斋节日期。查看官方阿联酋政府门户或关注当地新闻。

    2. 预留缓冲： 如果在斋月或开斋节季节有重要截止日期，预留缓冲天数。望月可能使庆祝活动推迟 24-48 小时。

    3. 了解周末： 阿联酋周末为周六 - 周日（2022 年从周五 - 周六改为）。这影响假日与周末的叠加方式。

    4. 尊重当地习俗： 斋月期间，白天在公共场合进食、饮水和吸烟是不合适的。许多餐厅关闭或缩短营业时间。

    对于游客来说，浮动假日意味着旅行时机很重要。开斋节期间旅游景点很美（装饰、节日氛围），但人多价高。斋月前一周实际上是 visiting 的好时机——游客少、价格低，你还能体验斋月的准备期。

    常见问题

    Q: 阿联酋开斋节日期提前多久宣布？

    A: 通常在节前 1-2 天，基于实际望月。最高委员会有时会提前一周宣布暂定日期，但正式日期最后时刻才确定。

    Q: 所有阿联酋酋长国都遵循相同的假日安排吗？

    A: 是的，联邦政府设定统一的公共假日。但某些地方性 observance 可能因酋长国而异。

    Q: 圣诞节是阿联酋公共假日吗？

    A: 圣诞节（12 月 25 日）被认可，许多基督教外籍人士放假。但与西方国家相比，庆祝不普遍。

    Q: 如果开斋节落在周末怎么办？

    A: 阿联酋政府通常会宣布补休。例如，如果开斋节落在周六，周一可能是假日。

title: Denmark, Norway, Finland: A Nordic Holidays Comparison
author: PubHoliday Research Team
excerpt: How do Denmark, Norway, and Finland celebrate differently? A comparison of Nordic holiday traditions, key dates, and the culture behind them.
content:
When people think of Nordic holidays, they often imagine a single unified calendar — somewhere between Swedish midsummer celebrations and Danish hygge winters. But the reality is more interesting. Denmark, Norway, and Finland each maintain distinct holiday traditions that reflect their unique histories, religions, and cultural identities.

Understanding these differences matters if you're planning a trip, doing business in the region, or simply curious about how neighboring countries celebrate differently. Let me break down what makes each nation's holiday calendar unique.

Denmark: Hygge and High Church

Denmark's holiday calendar balances Lutheran traditions with secular celebrations that emphasize togetherness. The Danes take their holidays seriously, and the concept of hygge — cozy togetherness — permeates many celebrations.

Key Danish Holidays:

  • New Year's Day (Nytår): January 1st, marked by fireworks and candied almonds
  • Maundy Thursday (Skærtorsdag): The Thursday before Easter, a public holiday
  • Good Friday (Langfredag): Quiet day of reflection
  • Easter Monday (Påskeaften): Family gatherings and egg hunts
  • National Day (Grundlovsdag): June 5th, celebrating the constitution
  • Christmas Eve (Juleaften): December 24th, the main celebration with roast duck and rice pudding

What makes Danish holidays distinctive is the emphasis on family and coziness. Even secular celebrations like Constitution Day feel intimate rather than grandiose.

Norway: Grit and Fjords

Norway's holiday calendar reflects its rugged landscape and proud independence. The Norwegians celebrate with more external enthusiasm than their Danish cousins, often taking to the outdoors even during traditional holidays.

Key Norwegian Holidays:

  • Constitution Day (Grunnlovsdagen): May 17th, the biggest celebration of the year with children's parades
  • Labour Day (Arbeiderens festdag): May 1st, marked by political speeches and celebrations
  • Ascension Day (Kristi Himmelfartsdag): Thursday before Pentecost
  • National Day (Syttende Mai): May 17th, children carry flags and sing songs
  • Christmas Eve (Julaften): December 24th, the main celebration with ham and rice porridge

Norwegian holidays often involve being outside, even in winter. The Constitution Day parade is one of the largest children's processions in the world, and many Norwegians celebrate by heading to the mountains or coast.

Finland: Silence and Saunas

Finnish holidays stand apart from their Nordic neighbors in several ways. The Finns tend toward quieter, more introspective celebrations, and their calendar includes unique national observances that have no direct equivalent in Denmark or Norway.

Key Finnish Holidays:

  • Independence Day (Itsenäisyyspäivä): December 6th, marked by the Presidential Reception in Helsinki
  • Midsummer (Juhannus): The Saturday between June 20-26, Finns flee to summer cottages
  • All Souls' Day (Pyhäinpäivä): Late October/early November, cemetery visits and candle lighting
  • Christmas Eve (Jouluaatto): December 24th, sauna first, then the meal
  • New Year's Eve (Uudenvuodenaatto): Bonfires and champagne

Finnish holidays often involve saunas, candles, and a respect for silence and nature. Independence Day feels more solemn than celebratory, and Midsummer is essentially a nationwide exodus to the countryside.

Comparing the Three: What's Different?

While Denmark, Norway, and Finland share some Christian holidays, the way each country celebrates reveals deeper cultural differences:

AspectDenmarkNorwayFinland
Celebration StyleCozy, intimateExternal, enthusiasticQuiet, reflective
National DayJune 5 (Constitution)May 17 (Independence)December 6 (Independence)
Summer FocusHygge outdoorsMountain/hikingCottage life
Winter FocusCandlelight, togethernessIndoor family timeSauna, darkness coping
Religious InfluenceStrong LutheranModerate LutheranModerate Lutheran + Orthodox

Why These Differences Matter

Understanding these holiday nuances matters for several reasons:

  • Travel Planning. If you visit Denmark during Christmas, expect cozy indoor gatherings. Norway during summer means outdoor adventures. Finland in winter requires embracing the darkness and cold.
  • Business Etiquette. Closing dates vary. Norwegian businesses may be closed on Constitution Day but open on other Nordic holidays. Finnish companies observe Independence Day but may operate during Danish National Day.
  • Cultural Respect. Showing up to a Danish hygge gathering with Norwegian exuberance might feel off. Bringing Finnish quiet reserve to a Norwegian parade could seem cold. Adapting to local celebration styles goes a long way.

The Shared Nordic Spirit

Despite these differences, the three countries share underlying values: a respect for nature, emphasis on family and community, and a tendency to celebrate simply rather than extravagantly. Whether it's a Danish hygge evening, a Norwegian Constitution Day parade, or a Finnish Midsummer bonfire, the spirit is the same — finding joy in simple, shared moments.

For travelers and expats, learning these differences isn't just about calendars. It's about understanding how these neighbors see the world differently, even when they share the same Nordic sun.

title: 丹麦、挪威、芬兰：北欧三国假日对比
author: PubHoliday Research Team
excerpt: 丹麦、挪威和芬兰的假日传统有何不同？对比北欧三国的假日、关键日期与背后文化。
content:
当人们想到北欧假日时，他们常常想象一个统一的日历——介于瑞典仲夏节和丹麦 hygge 冬季之间。但现实更有趣。丹麦、挪威和芬兰各自保持着独特的假日传统，反映了他们不同的历史、宗教和文化身份。

如果你计划旅行、在该地区经商，或者只是好奇邻国如何不同地庆祝，了解这些差异很重要。让我分析一下每个国家假日日历的独特之处。

丹麦：Hygge 和高教堂

丹麦的假日日历在路德宗传统和强调团聚的世俗庆祝之间取得平衡。丹麦人认真对待他们的假日，hygge（舒适团聚）的概念渗透到许多庆祝活动中。

主要丹麦假日：

  • 元旦（Nytår）： 1 月 1 日，以烟花和糖杏仁为标志
  • 濯足星期四（Skærtorsdag）： 复活节前的星期四，公共假日
  • 耶稣受难日（Langfredag）： 安静的反思日
  • 复活节星期一（Påskeaften）： 家庭聚会和寻蛋活动
  • 国庆日（Grundlovsdag）： 6 月 5 日，庆祝宪法
  • 平安夜（Juleaften）： 12 月 24 日，主要庆祝活动，有烤鸭和米布丁

丹麦假日的独特之处在于对家庭和舒适的强调。即使是像宪法日这样的世俗庆祝也感觉亲密而不是宏伟。

挪威：骨气与峡湾

挪威的假日日历反映了其崎岖的风景和骄傲的独立。挪威人比他们的丹麦表亲更热情地庆祝，即使在传统假日也常常走向户外。

主要挪威假日：

  • 国庆日（Grunnlovsdagen）： 5 月 17 日，一年中最大的庆祝活动，有儿童游行
  • 劳动节（Arbeiderens festdag）： 5 月 1 日，以政治演讲和庆祝活动为标志
  • Ascension Day（Kristi Himmelfartsdag）： Pentecost 前的星期四
  • 国庆日（Syttende Mai）： 5 月 17 日，儿童携带旗帜唱歌
  • 平安夜（Julaften）： 12 月 24 日，主要庆祝活动，有火腿和米粥

挪威假日通常涉及户外活动，即使在冬天也是如此。国庆日游行是世界上最大的儿童游行之一，许多挪威人庆祝时前往山区或海岸。

芬兰：寂静与桑拿

芬兰的假日与其北欧邻国在某些方面不同。芬兰人倾向于更安静、更内省的庆祝活动，他们的日历包括丹麦或挪威没有直接对应的独特国家纪念活动。

主要芬兰假日：

  • 独立日（Itsenäisyyspäivä）： 12 月 6 日，以赫尔辛基的总统招待会为标志
  • 仲夏（Juhannus）： 6 月 20-26 日之间的星期六，芬兰人逃离到夏季小屋
  • 诸灵节（Pyhäinpäivä）： 10 月底/11 月初，墓地访问和点蜡烛
  • 平安夜（Jouluaatto）： 12 月 24 日，先桑拿，然后用餐
  • 跨年夜（Uudenvuodenaatto）： 篝火和香槟

芬兰假日通常涉及桑拿、蜡烛，以及对寂静和自然的尊重。独立日感觉比庆祝活动更庄严，仲夏几乎是全国性的乡间迁徙。

三国比较：有什么不同？

虽然丹麦、挪威和芬兰共享一些基督教假日，但每个国家的庆祝方式揭示了更深层的文化差异：

方面丹麦挪威芬兰
庆祝风格舒适、亲密外向、热情安静、反思
国庆日6 月 5 日（宪法）5 月 17 日（独立）12 月 6 日（独立）
夏季重点户外 hygge登山/徒步小屋生活
冬季重点烛光、团聚室内家庭时间桑拿、应对黑暗
宗教影响强路德宗中等路德宗中等路德宗 + 东正教

为什么这些差异很重要

了解这些假日细微差别对几个原因很重要：

  • 旅行计划。 如果你圣诞节去丹麦，期待舒适的室内聚会。挪威夏天意味着户外冒险。芬兰冬天需要拥抱黑暗和寒冷。
  • 商务礼仪。 关闭日期各不相同。挪威企业在国庆日可能关闭，但在其他北欧假日开放。芬兰公司纪念独立日，但可能在丹麦国庆日营业。
  • 文化尊重。 带着挪威人的热情出现在丹麦 hygge 聚会可能感觉不对劲。在挪威游行中带上芬兰人的安静克制可能显得冷漠。适应当地庆祝方式意义重大。

共同的北欧精神

尽管存在这些差异，这三个国家共享潜在价值观：对自然的尊重、对家庭和社区的强调，以及倾向于简单庆祝而不是奢侈。无论是丹麦的 hygge 夜晚、挪威的国庆日游行还是芬兰的仲夏篝火，精神都是一样的——在简单、共享的时刻中找到快乐。

对于旅行者和移民来说，学习这些差异不仅仅是关于日历。它是关于理解这些邻居如何看待世界的不同，即使他们共享相同的北欧阳光。

title: Central & Eastern Europe: Czech, Greece, Hungary, Romania
author: PubHoliday Research Team
excerpt: Czechia, Greece, Hungary and Romania share a region but not a calendar. The 2026 fixed dates, the Easter split, and the civic holidays that define each country.
content:
Central and Eastern Europe does not share one holiday calendar. Czechia, Greece, Hungary, and Romania sit within a few hundred kilometers of each other, but their public-holiday rhythms come from different churches, different revolutions, and different ideas about what a day off is for. If you travel, work, or source suppliers across this region, the gaps will surprise you — most of all the Easter split in 2026.

This guide walks through the four 2026 calendars with the actual fixed dates, then explains where the movable feasts land and why it matters.

Czechia: Thirteen Quiet Holidays

Czechia observes 13 public holidays, almost all tied to national memory rather than shopping. The fixed dates in 2026:

  • Jan 1 — New Year's Day, doubled as the Day of the Renewal of the Czech State
  • May 1 — Labour Day
  • May 8 — Liberation Day (end of WWII in Europe)
  • Jul 5 — Saints Cyril and Methodius Day
  • Jul 6 — Jan Hus Day
  • Sep 28 — St. Wenceslas Day (Czech Statehood)
  • Oct 28 — Independent Czechoslovak State Day (1918)
  • Nov 17 — Struggle for Freedom and Democracy Day
  • Dec 24-26 — Christmas Eve, Christmas Day, St. Stephen's Day

The two July dates one day apart are easy to confuse, and Dec 24 is the main family celebration (not Dec 25). Easter is movable: in 2026 Good Friday falls on Apr 3 and Easter Monday on Apr 6, both public holidays. See the full list on the Czechia holidays page.

Greece: The Orthodox Calendar Rules

Greece blends Independence Day with a religious feast and leans on the Orthodox calendar, so its Easter moves to a different week than Czechia's. Fixed 2026 dates:

  • Jan 1 — New Year's Day
  • Jan 6 — Epiphany (Theophany)
  • Mar 25 — Independence Day, sharing the date with the Annunciation
  • May 1 — Labour Day
  • Aug 15 — Assumption (Dormition of the Theotokos)
  • Oct 28 — Ohi Day (the "No" of 1940)
  • Dec 25-26 — Christmas and St. Stephen's Day

Two dates do double duty: Jan 6 is both a feast and a holiday, and Mar 25 pairs independence with the Annunciation. The movable ones matter more here — Clean Monday (start of Lent) lands on Feb 23, and Orthodox Easter is Apr 12 in 2026, with Easter Monday on Apr 13. Check the Greece holidays page for the floating dates each year.

Hungary: Three Revolution Days

Hungary packs three civic-national holidays into the year and keeps Christmas on the Western calendar. Fixed 2026 dates:

  • Jan 1 — New Year's Day
  • Mar 15 — 1848 Revolution Memorial Day
  • May 1 — Labour Day
  • Aug 20 — State Foundation Day (St. Stephen's Day)
  • Oct 23 — 1956 Revolution Memorial Day
  • Nov 1 — All Saints' Day
  • Dec 25-26 — Christmas and St. Stephen's Day

Mar 15 and Oct 23 are the two revolution anniversaries; Aug 20 honors the first king. Easter follows the Western church in 2026: Apr 5 (Sunday) and Apr 6 (Monday). Full detail on the Hungary holidays page.

Romania: The Great Union

Romania's calendar is the most layered, with two January holidays and a midsummer saint's day. Fixed 2026 dates:

  • Jan 1-2 — New Year's Day (two days)
  • Jan 6 — Epiphany; Jan 7 — St. John the Baptist
  • Jan 24 — Union Day (the 1859 "Small Union")
  • May 1 — Labour Day
  • Jun 1 — Children's Day
  • Aug 15 — Dormition of the Theotokos
  • Nov 30 — St. Andrew's Day
  • Dec 1 — National Day (Great Union of 1918)
  • Dec 25-26 — Christmas and St. Stephen's Day

Dec 1 is the big one — parades in Bucharest and across the country. Like Greece, Romania follows the Orthodox church, so Easter is Apr 12 in 2026. The Romania holidays page tracks the floating dates.

What Differs, and Why It Bites

CountryPublic holidaysEaster 2026Signature civic day
Czechia13Apr 5-6 (Western)Oct 28
Greece~11Apr 12 (Orthodox)Mar 25 / Oct 28
Hungary~11Apr 5-6 (Western)Aug 20 / Oct 23
Romania~14Apr 12 (Orthodox)Dec 1

The Easter split is the trap. In 2026, Czechia and Hungary take Apr 6 off; Greece and Romania take Apr 13. If you schedule a regional meeting or a shipment across all four for "the week after Easter," you will miss one of them. Plan around both Mondays.

public-holidays.shop tracks public holidays across all four CEE countries, including the floating Orthodox Easter. Plan trips, check cross-border business closures, and never miss a key date. Visit public-holidays.shop to browse holidays by country, or read more regional roundups on our blog.

title: 捷克、希腊、匈牙利、罗马尼亚：中东欧公共假日盘点
author: PubHoliday Research Team
excerpt: 捷克、希腊、匈牙利、罗马尼亚同处中东欧，假日历却各走各的。2026 固定日期、复活节东西分裂、以及定义各国的公民假日。
content:
中东欧并没有一张统一的假日历。捷克、希腊、匈牙利、罗马尼亚彼此相距不过几百公里，但公共假日的节奏来自不同的教会、不同的革命，以及对于"放假究竟为了什么"的不同理解。如果你在这片区域旅行、出差或找供应商，那些差异会让你吃惊——尤其是 2026 年的复活节分裂。

这篇指南按四个国家的 2026 日历，列出确切的固定日期，再说明浮动节日落在哪天、为什么重要。

捷克：十三个安静的假日

捷克有 13 个公共假日，几乎都绑定民族记忆而不是购物。2026 固定日期：

  • 1 月 1 日 — 元旦，同时是捷克建国纪念日
  • 5 月 1 日 — 劳动节
  • 5 月 8 日 — 解放日（欧洲二战结束）
  • 7 月 5 日 — 西里尔与美多德日
  • 7 月 6 日 — 扬·胡斯日
  • 9 月 28 日 — 圣瓦茨拉夫日（捷克国庆）
  • 10 月 28 日 — 捷克斯洛伐克独立日（1918）
  • 11 月 17 日 — 争取自由与民主日
  • 12 月 24-26 日 — 圣诞夜、圣诞节、圣斯捷潘日

七月那两个只差一天的日期很容易混淆，而真正的家庭大餐在 12 月 24 日（不是 25 日）。复活节是浮动的：2026 年耶稣受难日是 4 月 3 日，复活节星期一是 4 月 6 日，都是公共假日。完整列表见 捷克假日页。

希腊：东正教历法说了算

希腊把独立日和一个宗教节庆叠在一起，并且倚重东正教历法，所以复活节比捷克晚一周。2026 固定日期：

  • 1 月 1 日 — 元旦
  • 1 月 6 日 — 主显节
  • 3 月 25 日 — 独立日，与圣母领报同一天
  • 5 月 1 日 — 劳动节
  • 8 月 15 日 — 圣母安息节（Dormition）
  • 10 月 28 日 — 说不日（Ohi Day，1940 年的"不"）
  • 12 月 25-26 日 — 圣诞节与圣斯捷潘日

有两个日期身兼两职：1 月 6 日既是节庆也是假日，3 月 25 日把独立与领报并在一天。浮动节日在这里更关键——洁净星期一（大斋首日）落在 2 月 23 日，东正教复活节在 2026 年是 4 月 12 日，复活节星期一是 4 月 13 日。每年的浮动日期见 希腊假日页。

匈牙利：三个革命纪念日

匈牙利一年塞进三个公民-民族假日，圣诞节走西方历法。2026 固定日期：

  • 1 月 1 日 — 元旦
  • 3 月 15 日 — 1848 年革命纪念日
  • 5 月 1 日 — 劳动节
  • 8 月 20 日 — 建国日（圣伊什特万日）
  • 10 月 23 日 — 1956 年革命纪念日
  • 11 月 1 日 — 万圣节
  • 12 月 25-26 日 — 圣诞节与圣斯捷潘日

3 月 15 日和 10 月 23 日是两个革命周年；8 月 20 日纪念第一位国王。复活节 2026 年随西方教会：4 月 5 日（周日）与 4 月 6 日（周一）。完整细节见 匈牙利假日页。

罗马尼亚：大统一

罗马尼亚的日历最"层叠"，一月有两个假日，盛夏还有一个圣人日。2026 固定日期：

  • 1 月 1-2 日 — 元旦（两天）
  • 1 月 6 日 — 主显节；1 月 7 日 — 圣约翰节
  • 1 月 24 日 — 统一日（1859 年"小统一"）
  • 5 月 1 日 — 劳动节
  • 6 月 1 日 — 儿童节
  • 8 月 15 日 — 圣母安息节
  • 11 月 30 日 — 圣安德烈日
  • 12 月 1 日 — 国庆日（1918 年大统一）
  • 12 月 25-26 日 — 圣诞节与圣斯捷潘日

12 月 1 日是重头戏——布加勒斯特和全国都有阅兵。和希腊一样，罗马尼亚随东正教会，所以 2026 年复活节是 4 月 12 日。浮动日期见 罗马尼亚假日页。

差异在哪，为什么坑人

国家公共假日数2026 复活节标志性公民日
捷克134 月 5-6 日（西方）10 月 28 日
希腊约 114 月 12 日（东正教）3 月 25 日 / 10 月 28 日
匈牙利约 114 月 5-6 日（西方）8 月 20 日 / 10 月 23 日
罗马尼亚约 144 月 12 日（东正教）12 月 1 日

复活节分裂是大坑。2026 年，捷克和匈牙利在 4 月 6 日放假；希腊和罗马尼亚在 4 月 13 日。如果你为"复活节后那周"安排四国跨区域会议或发货，会漏掉其中一边。两个周一都留出余量。

关于 public-holidays.shop

title: Asia Beyond: Turkey, Russia, Thailand, Malaysia, Indonesia, Philippines
author: Maya Chen
excerpt: A 2026 public-holiday roundup across Turkey, Russia, Thailand, Malaysia, Indonesia, and the Philippines, with dates, traditions, and bridge-day tactics.
content:
Asian public holidays stretch far beyond China and Japan. For 2026, six countries on the map, Turkey, Russia, Thailand, Malaysia, Indonesia, and the Philippines, each run their own calendar of fixed and floating days that trip up travelers and remote teams. This roundup collects the dates that matter, the traditions behind them, and the bridge-day tricks that turn one day off into a four-day stretch.

Turkey Holidays 2026

Turkey mixes national days with two major Islamic festivals that move with the lunar calendar. Republic Day lands on October 29. The two Eid breaks, Eid al-Fitr and Eid al-Adha, shift earlier each year, so 2026 places them in the spring and summer. Istanbul and Ankara empty out around these dates, and domestic flights sell out fast.

Russia Holidays 2026

Russia takes a blunt approach: a long winter block around New Year and Defender of the Fatherland Day on February 23, then a spring cluster with International Women's Day on March 8 and Spring and Labour Day on May 1. The May holidays stretch from May 1 to May 9, Victory Day, giving locals a full week if they bridge with a single vacation day.

Thailand Holidays 2026

Thailand's calendar is dense with royal and Buddhist observances. Songkran, the April water festival, is effectively a multi-day national pause. The King's Birthday in July and Father's Day in December close the year. Many Thai holidays are declared only weeks ahead, so teams should watch the royal gazette before locking plans.

Malaysia Holidays 2026

Malaysia splits its calendar by state, but a shared national set covers Merdeka Day on August 31 and Malaysia Day on September 16. Islamic festivals like Hari Raya Aidilfitri shift yearly. Because states differ, a Kuala Lumpur office may be open while Penang is dark, a detail that matters for regional operations.

Indonesia Holidays 2026

Indonesia pairs fixed national days, Independence Day on August 17, with a moving set of Islamic holidays. The government often declares joint leave, cuti bersama, around Eid, extending the break by several days. Jakarta grinds to a near stop, and the exodus, mudik, back to home towns is one of the largest annual human migrations anywhere.

Philippines Holidays 2026

The Philippines lists both regular and special non-working days. Rizal Day on December 30, Independence Day on June 12, and a cluster of religious dates fill the year. Special days pay less strictly, so some employers stay open. Planning around the regular national holidays is the safe bet for cross-team coordination.

Quick Comparison of the Six

CountryAnchor holiday 2026Notable quirk
TurkeyRepublic Day, Oct 29Two moving Eid breaks
RussiaVictory Day, May 9Long May block
ThailandSongkran, AprilLate gazette declarations
MalaysiaMerdeka Day, Aug 31State-by-state splits
IndonesiaIndependence Day, Aug 17Joint leave around Eid
PhilippinesRizal Day, Dec 30Regular vs special days

Plan Around the Gaps

The smart move is to map each country's floating days early, then place team deadlines and travel between the fixed anchors. A single bridge day can unlock a four-day weekend in Russia or Malaysia, while Thailand and Indonesia reward flexible scheduling more than strict planning.

For country-by-country detail, visit public-holidays.shop, open the Turkey holidays page, or browse the full blog for more regional roundups.

faq.question: Which of these six has the most public holidays in 2026?
faq.answer: Indonesia and Malaysia add the most moving Islamic observances on top of fixed national days, but the raw count shifts every year with lunar dates, so the lead changes between them.

faq.question: Do Thailand and Indonesia announce holidays late?
faq.answer: Yes. Thailand often declares some dates only weeks ahead through the royal gazette, and Indonesia sets the joint leave around Eid close to the event.

faq.question: How do I bridge one day into a long weekend?
faq.answer: In Russia and Malaysia, placing one vacation day next to a fixed holiday like Victory Day or Merdeka Day often creates a four-day break.

title: 亚洲不止中日：土耳其、俄罗斯、泰国、马来西亚、印尼、菲律宾 2026 公共假期盘点
author: 陈思远
excerpt: 2026 年亚洲公共假期盘点，覆盖土耳其、俄罗斯、泰国、马来西亚、印尼与菲律宾的日期、习俗与拼假技巧。
content:
亚洲公共假期远不止中国和日本。2026 年，地图上这六个国家，土耳其、俄罗斯、泰国、马来西亚、印尼、菲律宾，各自有一套固定与浮动交织的假日表，常常让旅行者和跨国远程团队踩坑。这篇盘点把真正要紧的日期、背后的习俗，以及把一天假期拼成四天连休的技巧一并收进来。

土耳其 2026 公共假期

土耳其把国庆日和两个随阴历移动的伊斯兰大节混在一起。共和国日固定在 10 月 29 日。开斋节与宰牲节每年提前约十天，2026 年落在春夏两季。这两天前后伊斯坦布尔和安卡拉几乎空城，国内机票很快售罄。

俄罗斯 2026 公共假期

俄罗斯的风格很直接：新年前后一长段冬休，加上 2 月 23 日祖国保卫者日；春天则聚在 3 月 8 日国际妇女节和 5 月 1 日劳动节。5 月从 1 日一路连到 9 日胜利日，只要再休一天年假，本地人就能凑出整整一周。

泰国 2026 公共假期

泰国的日历塞满了王室与佛教节日。四月泼水节（Songkran）几乎是全国性的多日暂停。七月王诞、十二月父亲节收尾全年。不少泰国假日提前几周才公布，团队在敲定计划前最好盯紧王室公报。

马来西亚 2026 公共假期

马来西亚按州分日历，但全国共用的一套装假覆盖 8 月 31 日独立日和 9 月 16 日马来西亚日。开斋节这类伊斯兰节日每年浮动。因为各州不同，吉隆坡办公室上班时槟城可能休息，做区域运营的人得留心。

印尼 2026 公共假期

印尼把固定国庆日（8 月 17 日独立日）和一串浮动的伊斯兰假日叠加。政府常在开斋节前后宣布共同休假（cuti bersama），把假期延长好几天。雅加达近乎停摆，而返乡潮（mudik）是全球最大规模的人口年度迁徙之一。

菲律宾 2026 公共假期

菲律宾分"常规"与"特别不工作"两类假日。12 月 30 日黎刹日、6 月 12 日独立日，加上一串宗教日期填满全年。特别日薪水算法较松，部分雇主照常开工。跨团队协调时，围绕常规国庆日来排期最稳妥。

六国速览对比

国家2026 锚点假日明显特点
土耳其共和国日 10/29两个浮动开斋/宰牲节
俄罗斯胜利日 5/9五月长连假
泰国泼水节 4 月临近才公布
马来西亚独立日 8/31各州不一
印尼独立日 8/17开斋节共同休假
菲律宾黎刹日 12/30常规日 vs 特别日

围着空档做计划

聪明的做法是先把每个国家浮动假日标早，再把团队截止日和出行排进固定锚点之间。在俄罗斯或马来西亚，只要拿一天年假去拼胜利日或独立日，常常就能换来四天连休；泰国和印尼则更吃灵活的排期而非死板计划。

想逐国细看，欢迎访问 public-holidays.shop，打开 土耳其假日页，或在 blog 读更多区域盘点。

faq.question: 这六国里 2026 年哪国公共假期最多？
faq.answer: 印尼和马来西亚在固定国庆日之上叠加了最多的浮动伊斯兰节日，但因为阴历每年都在变，具体名次会在两者之间来回换。

faq.question: 泰国和印尼会临时才公布假日吗？
faq.answer: 会。泰国常提前几周通过王室公报才定下某些日期，印尼的共同休假也常在开斋节临近时才公布。

faq.question: 怎么把一天假期拼成长周末？
faq.answer: 在俄罗斯和马来西亚，把一天年假放在胜利日或独立日旁边，往往就能凑出四天连休。

title: Worldwide Holidays at a Glance: 46+ Countries Compared
author: Maya Chen
excerpt: A side-by-side look at public holidays by country across 46+ nations, who gets the most days off, who gets the fewest, and how the world holidays list breaks down by region.
content:
If you have ever tried to schedule a meeting across three time zones, you already know that public holidays by country are anything but uniform. This worldwide roundup lines up 46+ nations at a glance, so you can see who gets the most time off and who barely stops. We compare counts, clusters, and the quirks that trip up remote teams.

Public holidays by country: the raw count

The headline number varies more than most people expect. At one end, a handful of nations grant under ten paid public holidays a year. At the other, several cluster around fifteen to twenty once you add regional and substitute days. The world holidays list below groups them so the gaps are easy to read.

The world holidays list, region by region

Europe leans on fixed Christian and civic dates, with extra days added by individual states. Asia mixes lunar and solar calendars, so counts shift year to year. The Americas stack national independence days with a few floating observances. Africa and the Middle East follow their own religious and civic rhythm entirely.

RegionTypical public holidaysWhat moves the count
Europe10–15State-added days, substitute Mondays
Asia11–18Lunar dates, royal and Buddhist observances
Americas8–14Independence days, floating civic dates
Africa & Middle East9–16Islamic calendar, national days

Where you get the most, and the least

Countries with the fewest statutory days often make up for it with generous annual leave, while the most generous holiday lists sit alongside shorter leave entitlements. Looking at public holidays by country next to leave allowance tells the real story, not the headline number alone.

Planning across borders

When a team spans regions, map the floating days first and place deadlines between the fixed anchors. One bridge day can unlock a four-day weekend in several countries at once, and a shared quiet week in late December is the one window almost everyone respects.

For country-by-country detail, open public-holidays.shop, browse the blog for more regional roundups, or jump straight to the US holidays page.

faq.question: Which country has the most public holidays?
faq.answer: No single country wins every year, because lunar-based holidays move. India and several Southeast Asian nations routinely top the list once regional and religious days stack, often landing in the high teens to low twenties.

faq.question: Do all countries count holidays the same way?
faq.answer: No. Some count only national statutory days, others include state or provincial days, and many add substitute days when a holiday lands on a weekend. That is why a raw count between two countries can be misleading.

faq.question: How do I compare holidays by country for a remote team?
faq.answer: Pull each team member's country into one calendar, mark the floating days early, and place deadlines between the fixed anchors. A single bridge day can create a long weekend across several countries at once.

title: 全球假日一览：46+ 国家横向对比
author: 陈思远
excerpt: 把 46+ 个国家的公共假日横向摆在一起：谁放假最多、谁最少，以及全球假日列表按区域怎么分。
content:
如果你曾经试着在三个时区之间排会议，就会知道公共假日按国家差异有多大。这篇全球假日一览把 46+ 个国家横向摆在一起，一眼看清谁放假最多、谁几乎不歇，以及各地假日的排布逻辑，方便远程团队和旅行者提前规划。

公共假日按国家：先数天数

各国公共假日的总数，差距比多数人想的大。一端是每年不到十天的国家，另一端加上地方与补休日后能逼近十五到二十天。下面的全球假日列表按区域归组，方便直接对比。

全球假日列表：分区域看

欧洲以固定基督教与公民节日为主，各州还会补几天。亚洲混用阴历与阳历，所以数量每年浮动。美洲把独立日与几个浮动公民日叠在一起。非洲与中东则完全按自己的宗教与国庆节奏走。

区域常见公共假日数影响数量的因素
欧洲10–15各州增补日、补休周一
亚洲11–18阴历日期、王室与佛教节日
美洲8–14独立日、浮动公民日
非洲与中东9–16伊斯兰历、国庆日

谁放假最多，谁最少

法定假日最少的国家，往往用更长的年假来补；而假日最多的地方，年假反而偏短。把"公共假日按国家"和年假额度放在一起看，才看得到真实全貌，而不是被单一数字误导。

跨国怎么排期

团队跨区域时，先把浮动假日标出来，再把截止日排在固定锚点之间。只要一天补休，好几个国家能同时凑出四天连休；而十二月底那周几乎全球都安静，是唯一大家都买账的窗口。

faq.question: 哪个国家公共假日最多？
faq.answer: 没有哪个国家每年都稳居第一，因为阴历节日会浮动。印度和几个东南亚国家把地方与宗教假日叠起来后，常常排到接近二十天。

faq.question: 各国计算假日的方式一样吗？
faq.answer: 不一样。有的只算全国法定日，有的把州或省的日子也算进去，还有不少会在假日撞上周末时补一天。所以两个国家的原始数字直接比，很容易误读。

faq.question: 远程团队怎么按国家对比假日？
faq.answer: 把每位成员所在国放进同一张日历，早点标出浮动假日，再把截止日排在固定锚点之间。只要一天补休，好几个国家就能同时凑出长周末。

title.en: Eastern Europe Public Holidays 2026: Complete Travel Guide
title.zh: 2026 东欧公共假期全攻略：旅行者必备指南

description.en: Discover all major public holidays in Eastern Europe for 2026, including Poland, Czech Republic, Hungary, and more. Plan your trips around local celebrations.
description.zh: 了解 2026 年东欧主要公共假期，包括波兰、捷克、匈牙利等。根据当地庆典规划你的行程。

body.en:
Eastern Europe offers a rich tapestry of cultural celebrations throughout the year. Understanding local holidays is essential for travelers who want to experience authentic local culture.

## Poland
Poland's major holidays include:
- **New Year's Day** (January 1): Celebrated with fireworks and festive meals
- **Easter Sunday** (variable, usually March-April): Traditional market breakfast with blessings
- **Constitution Day** (May 3): National holiday with parades and cultural events
- **Assumption Day** (August 15): Important religious holiday
- **All Saints' Day** (November 1): Families visit cemeteries to honor deceased relatives

## Czech Republic
Key Czech holidays:
- **Czech Statehood Day** (September 28): Celebrates Saint Wenceslas
- **Independence Day** (November 17): Commemorates the 1989 Velvet Revolution
- **Christmas Eve** (December 24): Family gathering with traditional dinner

## Hungary
Notable Hungarian celebrations:
- **National Day** (March 15): Commemorates the 1848 Revolution
- **State Foundation Day** (August 20): Celebrates Saint Stephen and the founding of Hungary
- **All Saints' Day** (November 1): Similar to Poland, families visit cemeteries

## Travel Tips
- **Book accommodations early**: Hotels fill up quickly during major holidays
- **Check business closures**: Many shops and restaurants close on public holidays
- **Embrace local traditions**: Joining celebrations offers unique cultural experiences
- **Plan transportation**: Public transport may have reduced schedules

Understanding Eastern European holidays enriches your travel experience and helps you connect with local culture on a deeper level.
body.zh:
东欧拥有丰富的文化庆典传统。了解当地假期对于想要体验正宗当地文化的旅行者至关重要。

## 波兰
波兰的主要假期包括：
- **元旦**（1 月 1 日）：以烟花和节日餐庆祝

- **宪法日**（5 月 3 日）：国庆日，有游行和文化活动
- **圣母升天日**（8 月 15 日）：重要宗教节日
- **诸圣日**（11 月 1 日）：家人前往墓地纪念逝去的亲人

## 捷克共和国
主要捷克假期：
- **捷克国庆日**（9 月 28 日）：庆祝圣温塞斯拉斯
- **独立日**（11 月 17 日）：纪念 1989 年天鹅绒革命
- **平安夜**（12 月 24 日）：家庭聚会与传统晚餐

 notable 匈牙利庆典：

- **检查营业时间**：许多商店和餐馆在公共假期关闭
- **融入当地传统**：参加庆典提供独特的文化体验
- **规划交通**：公共交通可能在假期期间减少班次

了解东欧假期能丰富您的旅行体验，帮助您更深入地连接当地文化。

title: UK Long Weekend Math: Bank Holiday Leave Hacks
author: Local Expert
excerpt: UK long weekend hacks for bank holiday travel.
content:
English Version

The UK's bank holiday system is one of the most flexible in Europe — if you know how to use it. Here's the complete guide to maximizing your long weekends in 2026.

How UK Bank Holidays Work

The UK gets 8 bank holidays per year (8 in England & Wales, 9 in Scotland). They're fixed dates, which means you can plan around them months in advance. The real magic happens when a bank holiday falls on a Tuesday or Thursday.

The 2026 Long Weekend Calendar

| Date | Bank Holiday | Long Weekend Strategy |

|------|-------------|----------------------|

| Jan 1 | New Year's Day | Already a Thursday — extended weekend possible |

| Apr 10 | Good Friday | Friday + Saturday = 4-day break |

| Apr 13 | Easter Monday | Monday holiday — easy 4-day weekend |

| May 4 | Early May Bank Holiday | Tuesday — take Wednesday = 5 days off |

| May 25 | Spring Bank Holiday | Monday — natural long weekend |

| Aug 31 | Summer Bank Holiday (Scotland) | Varies by region |

| Sep 1 | Summer Bank Holiday (England) | Monday — plan a Thursday off |

| Dec 25 | Christmas Day | Already Saturday 2026 — take Fri 24th |

| Dec 28 | Boxing Day | Monday — bridges the gap |

The Tuesday/Thursday Hack

This is the single most powerful trick:

- **Tuesday bank holiday**: Take the Wednesday before = 4-day weekend

- **Thursday bank holiday**: Take the Friday after = 4-day weekend

- **Wednesday bank holiday**: Take both Tuesday and Thursday = 5 days off

Real Example: May Early May Bank Holiday 2026

The Early May bank holiday falls on Tuesday, May 4th. Take Wednesday May 5th off, and you get:

- Monday May 3 (regular)

- Tuesday May 4 (bank holiday)

- Wednesday May 5 (your day off)

- Thursday May 6

- Friday May 7

- **That's 5 days off using just 1 personal day**

International Comparison

| Country | Bank Holidays/Year | Avg Long Weekend Potential |

|---------|-------------------|--------------------------|

| UK | 8 | Very high (fixed dates) |

| France | 11 | Medium |

| Germany | 10-13 (varies) | Medium |

| Spain | 9-14 (varies) | Low-Medium |

| USA | 10 federal | Low (floating holidays) |

Pro Tips

1. **Stack with summer leave**: The Aug bank holiday in England is late August — perfect for stretching summer holidays

2. **Check your region**: Scotland has different bank holidays (including St Andrew's Day)

3. **Use the "bridge day" concept**: A workday between a weekend and a holiday becomes a bridge day — plan these strategically

中文版本

英国长周末攻略：银行假日的请假算法

英国的银行假日制度是欧洲最灵活的之一——只要你懂得如何使用。以下是 2026 年最大化你的长周末的完整指南。

#### 英国银行假日规则

英国每年有 8 个银行假日（英格兰和威尔士 8 个，苏格兰 9 个）。日期固定，这意味着你可以提前数月规划。真正的妙处在于当银行假日落在周二或周四时。

#### 2026 年长周末日历

| 日期 | 银行假日 | 长周末策略 |

|------|---------|-----------|

| 1月1日 | 新年 | 已在周四——可延长周末 |

| 4月10日 | 耶稣受难日 | 周五+周六=4天假期 |

| 4月13日 | 复活节周一 | 周一假日——轻松4天周末 |

| 5月4日 | 五一银行假日 | 周二——请周三=休5天 |

| 5月25日 | 春季银行假日 | 周一——自然长周末 |

| 8月31日 | 夏季银行假日（苏格兰）| 各区域不同 |

| 9月1日 | 夏季银行假日（英格兰）| 周一——计划请周四 |

| 12月25日 | 圣诞节 | 2026年已是周六——请周五24号 |

| 12月28日 | 节礼日 | 周一——连接假期 |

#### 周二/周四技巧

这是最强大的技巧：

- **周二银行假日**：请周三前一天 = 4天周末

- **周四银行假日**：请周五后一天 = 4天周末

- **周三银行假日**：请周二和周四两天 = 休5天

#### 实战示例：2026 年五一银行假日

五一银行假日在周二，5月4日。请5月5日周三休息，结果：

- 周一5月3日（正常）

- 周二5月4日（银行假日）

- 周三5月5日（你的假期）

- 周四5月6日

- 周五5月7日

- **仅用1天年假换来5天假期**

#### 国际对比

| 国家 | 年银行假日数 | 长周末潜力 |

|------|------------|-----------|

| 英国 | 8 | 非常高（固定日期）|

| 法国 | 11 | 中等 |

| 德国 | 10-13（各州不同）| 中等 |

| 西班牙 | 9-14（各区域不同）| 低-中等 |

| 美国 | 10个联邦假日 | 低（浮动假日）|

#### 专家建议

1. **与年假叠加**：英格兰8月的银行假日在8月底——非常适合延长暑假

2. **检查你的区域**：苏格兰有不同的银行假日（包括圣安德鲁日）

3. **善用"桥假"概念**：周末和假日之间的工作日成为桥假——策略性安排

title: Canada Long Weekends 2026: Provincial Leave Pairing Guide
author: Local Expert
excerpt: Pair each 2026 Canadian statutory holiday with the right leave days, province by province.
content:
Canada Long Weekends 2026: The Provincial Leave Pairing Guide

Canada has no single holiday calendar. There are federal holidays, and then there are the statutory holidays each province actually closes for. That split is annoying when you are booking flights and genuinely useful when you are trying to turn one day off into four.

This guide pairs each 2026 statutory holiday with the leave days that stretch it furthest, province by province.

How Canadian stat holidays actually work

Nine holidays are observed federally, but provinces add, drop, or rename them. Boxing Day is statutory in Ontario but not in Quebec. Family Day exists in most provinces but lands on different dates. Remembrance Day is a stat holiday in BC and Alberta, a normal workday in Ontario and Quebec.

Practically, that means your long-weekend potential depends on where you work, not where you live in the abstract sense.

The 2026 pairing table

| Holiday | Date (2026) | Province | Pairing trick |

| New Year’s Day | Jan 1 (Thu) | All | Take Fri Jan 2 → 4 days |

| Family Day | Feb 16 (Mon) | AB, BC, ON, SK, NB | Natural 3-day weekend |

| Good Friday | Apr 3 (Fri) | All | Let weekend carry it → 4 days |

| Victoria Day | May 18 (Mon) | Most | Take Fri May 15 → 4 days |

| Canada Day | Jul 1 (Wed) | All | Take Thu+Fri → 5 days |

| Civic Holiday | Aug 3 (Mon) | Most | Natural 3-day weekend |

| Labour Day | Sep 7 (Mon) | All | Natural 3-day weekend |

| Thanksgiving | Oct 12 (Mon) | Most | Take Fri Oct 9 → 4 days |

| Remembrance Day | Nov 11 (Wed) | BC, AB, SK | Take Thu+Fri → 5 days |

| Christmas | Dec 25 (Fri) | All | Already a 3-day frame |

| Boxing Day | Dec 26 (Sat) | ON, NL | Observed Mon Dec 28 |

The Wednesday rule

A Wednesday holiday is the best kind, because two leave days on either side buy you five consecutive days off. Canada Day 2026 lands on a Wednesday, and Remembrance Day does too in the three provinces that observe it. Those are the two dates worth protecting early, because everyone in the office will want them.

Provincial traps to avoid

  • Quebec: no Family Day, no Boxing Day stat. Your February long weekend does not exist unless you take leave.
  • Ontario: no Remembrance Day stat, but Boxing Day is observed on Dec 28 when Christmas falls on a Friday.
  • BC and Alberta: Remembrance Day is statutory — pair it with two leave days for a rare November break.
  • Atlantic provinces: several local civic holidays are municipal, not provincial, so check your city hall.

Frequently asked

Is Boxing Day a statutory holiday everywhere in Canada?

No. It is statutory in Ontario, Newfoundland and Labrador, and federally regulated workplaces, but not in Quebec, BC, or Alberta.

Do I get a day off if a stat holiday falls on a weekend?

Usually yes, but the substitute day is set by provincial employment standards, and it is often the following Monday.

title: 2026 加拿大长周末：各省年假搭配法
author: 本地专家
excerpt: 按省梳理 2026 年每个法定假日，并给出把它拉成 4-5 天的最优请假方案。
content:
2026 加拿大长周末：各省年假搭配法

加拿大没有统一的假日日历。有联邦法定假日，也有各省真正放假的日子。订机票时这套差异很烦人，但想用一天假换四天休息时，它又特别有用。

本文按省梳理 2026 年每个法定假日，并给出把它拉长的请假方案。

法定假日到底怎么算

联邦层面有 9 个假日，但各省会增删或改名。节礼日在安省是法定假日，在魁省不是；家庭日多数省份都有，但日期不同；国殇纪念日在 BC 和阿尔伯塔是法定假日，在安省和魁省只是普通工作日。

所以你的长周末潜力，取决于你在哪工作。

2026 年搭配表

| 假日 | 2026 日期 | 适用省份 | 搭配技巧 |

| 元旦 | 1月1日（周四）| 全国 | 请 1月2日周五 → 休 4 天 |

| 家庭日 | 2月16日（周一）| AB/BC/ON/SK/NB | 天然三天周末 |

| 耶稣受难日 | 4月3日（周五）| 全国 | 连周末 → 休 4 天 |

| 维多利亚日 | 5月18日（周一）| 多数省 | 请 5月15日周五 → 休 4 天 |

| 加拿大日 | 7月1日（周三）| 全国 | 请周四+周五 → 休 5 天 |

| 市政日 | 8月3日（周一）| 多数省 | 天然三天周末 |

| 劳动节 | 9月7日（周一）| 全国 | 天然三天周末 |

| 感恩节 | 10月12日（周一）| 多数省 | 请 10月9日周五 → 休 4 天 |

| 国殇纪念日 | 11月11日（周三）| BC/AB/SK | 请周四+周五 → 休 5 天 |

| 圣诞节 | 12月25日（周五）| 全国 | 本身已是三天 |

| 节礼日 | 12月26日（周六）| ON/NL | 顺延至 12月28日周一 |

周三法则

周三的假日最值钱：前后各请一天，就能换到连续五天。2026 年加拿大日落在周三，国殇纪念日在观察它的三个省也落在周三。这两个日期值得早早锁定，因为全公司都想要。

各省的坑

  • 魁省：没有家庭日，节礼日也不是法定。二月的长周末不存在，除非你请假。
  • 安省：国殇纪念日不是法定，但圣诞落在周五时，节礼日顺延到 12月28日。
  • BC 与阿尔伯塔：国殇纪念日是法定，搭配两天年假换一个罕见的 11 月假期。
  • 大西洋省份：若干市政假日属市级规定，需查当地市政府。

常见问题

节礼日在加拿大全境都是法定假日吗？

不是。安省、纽芬兰与拉布拉多、以及联邦监管行业属法定，魁省、BC、阿尔伯塔不是。

法定假日撞上周末会补休吗？

通常会，但补休日由各省劳动标准规定，多数情况下是随后的周一。

title: Australia Long Weekends: Hop Between States
author: Local Expert
excerpt: Each Australian state runs its own holiday calendar. Here are the 2026 long weekends, and how to hop a border to catch the ones your state skips.
content:
Australia Day is the same everywhere. Almost nothing else is. An australia long weekend depends on which state you are standing in, because each state keeps its own Labour Days, show days and regional holidays. Travellers get this wrong every year: they book a Monday off, then find the shops open and their friends at work.

Plan around that split rather than against it and the calendar widens. This guide maps the 2026 long weekends state by state, then shows how to cross a border to catch the ones your own state skips.

Eight calendars, not one

Australia shares a small set of national holidays: New Year’s Day, Australia Day, Good Friday, Easter Monday, Anzac Day, Christmas and Boxing Day. Everything beyond that is decided in each state.

Labour Day is the clearest proof. It lands on a different date in almost every state. King’s Birthday is the second Monday of June for most of the country, but Queensland moves it to October and Western Australia proclaims its own date each year. So a simple question like “is a long weekend coming up” has no single national answer.

2026 long weekends by state

The table below lists every Monday or Friday that most workers get off somewhere in the country. Read the “where” column carefully, because that is where the hopping starts.

Long weekend2026 dateWhere it appliesShape
Australia DayMon 26 JanAll statesNatural three-day break
WA Labour DayMon 2 MarWA onlyThree days out west
March holidayMon 9 MarVIC, TAS, ACT, SAThree days while NSW and QLD work
EasterFri 3 Apr to Mon 6 AprAll statesFour days, no leave needed
QLD Labour Day and NT May DayMon 4 MayQLD, NTThree days in the north
WA DayMon 1 JunWA onlyThree days before the rest join in
King’s BirthdayMon 8 JunMost statesThree days, minus QLD and WA
NT Picnic DayMon 3 AugNT onlyTop End three-day break
October holidayMon 5 OctQLD, NSW, ACT, SAThree days, VIC and TAS at work
Melbourne CupTue 3 NovVICA Tuesday off, so take Monday too
Christmas and Boxing DayFri 25 DecAll statesAlready a long frame; Boxing Day observed Mon 28 Dec

State holiday hopping: the four best windows

State holiday hopping works best near a border. Live in Albury-Wodonga, Tweed Heads, Canberra or the Gold Coast and half your weekends sit within driving distance of a second calendar.

  • 2 and 9 March. WA takes the first Monday, then VIC, TAS, ACT and SA take the next one. NSW and QLD get neither.
  • 4 May. QLD Labour Day and NT May Day run together while the southern states keep working. A good week to head north.
  • 1 and 8 June. WA Day comes first, then King’s Birthday for most other states. QLD and WA sit out the second.
  • 5 October. QLD, NSW, ACT and SA all take this Monday. VIC and TAS do not, so a Melbourne to Sydney trip buys you the day.

Planning an aussie long weekend without burning leave

A crisp aussie long weekend does not need annual leave when the holiday already falls on a Monday or Friday. Check the date first, then decide whether an extra bridge day is worth it.

Easter 2026 is the strongest block of the year. Good Friday 3 April through Easter Monday 6 April gives four consecutive days with no leave at all. Anzac Day falls on a Saturday in 2026 and most states do not add a substitute, so do not plan a trip around it. Christmas Day lands on a Friday and Boxing Day on the Saturday, which pushes the Boxing Day substitute to Monday 28 December in most states.

Book early for the March and October Mondays. Those are the weekends when an entire state moves at once and coastal accommodation fills months ahead.

Frequently asked

Do all Australian states get the same public holidays?

No. Only the national holidays are shared. Labour Day, King’s Birthday and regional show days differ by state, and some councils add their own.

Does Anzac Day create a long weekend in 2026?

Not really. 25 April 2026 is a Saturday, and most states do not observe a substitute day.

Which state has the most long weekends?

South Australia and Victoria usually come out ahead, because both stack a March holiday, the June King’s Birthday and an October Labour Day on top of everything national.

Can I just travel to a neighbouring state for its long weekend?

Yes, and people do. The day off belongs to the state, not to your address, so a short drive across a border is enough to join it.

title: 澳大利亚长周末：州际跳槽式度假
author: 本地专家
excerpt: 澳大利亚各州假日各不相同。本文梳理 2026 年长周末，并讲清如何跨州界去蹭自己州没有的那几天。
content:
澳大利亚长周末：州际跳槽式度假

澳大利亚国庆日全国一样，其余几乎都不是。一个 australia long weekend 取决于你在哪个州：劳工节、展览日、地区假日各州自有安排。游客常搞错，请好周一，结果商店照开、朋友照常上班。

顺着这套差异安排，日历反而会变宽。本文按州梳理 2026 年长周末，再讲怎么跨州界蹭自己州没有的那几天。

不是一本日历，而是八本

全国共享的只有元旦、国庆日、耶稣受难日、复活节周一、澳新军团日、圣诞节和节礼日，其余由各州自定。

劳工节在全国几乎每个州日期都不同。英王诞辰多数州在 6 月第二个周一，昆士兰挪到 10 月，西澳每年另行公布。所以「最近有没有长周末」没有全国统一答案。

2026 年各州长周末一览

下表列出全国范围内可休的每个周一或周五。第三列是关键，跳槽机会就藏在那里。

长周末2026 日期适用地区
国庆日1 月 26 日 周一全国
西澳劳工节3 月 2 日 周一仅西澳
三月假日3 月 9 日 周一维州、塔州、首都领地、南澳
复活节4 月 3 日至 6 日全国
昆州劳工节与北领地五一节5 月 4 日 周一昆州、北领地
西澳日6 月 1 日 周一仅西澳
英王诞辰6 月 8 日 周一多数州
北领地野餐日8 月 3 日 周一仅北领地
十月假日10 月 5 日 周一昆州、新州、首都领地、南澳
墨尔本杯11 月 3 日 周二仅维州
圣诞与节礼日12 月 25 日 周五全国

州际跳槽：四个最佳窗口

州际跳槽在州界附近最好用。住在 Albury-Wodonga、Tweed Heads、堪培拉或黄金海岸，你有一半周末离另一本日历只有一脚油门。

  • 3 月 2 日与 9 日。西澳先休，维州、塔州、首都领地和南澳后一周跟上，新州与昆州两天都没有。
  • 5 月 4 日。昆州劳工节与北领地五一节同日，南方照常上班。
  • 6 月 1 日与 8 日。西澳日在前，多数州英王诞辰在后，昆州与西澳都不参与第二次。
  • 10 月 5 日。昆州、新州、首都领地、南澳都休，维州与塔州不休。

不烧年假，过一个地道的 aussie long weekend

假日落在周一或周五时，一个地道的 aussie long weekend 不需要动年假。先看日期，再决定要不要多搭一天桥。

2026 年最强的一段是复活节，4 月 3 日到 6 日连休四天，一天年假不占。澳新军团日落在周六，多数州不补休，别围着它做计划。

三月与十月那两个周一要早订，一整个州同时出动，海边住宿往往提前几个月满房。

常见问题

各州公共假日一样吗？

不一样。只有全国性假日共享，劳工节、英王诞辰与地区展览日各州不同。

2026 年澳新军团日能凑长周末吗？

基本不能。4 月 25 日是周六，多数州不设补休。

可以直接去邻州蹭长周末吗？

可以。假日属于州，不属于住址，开车过界就能一起休。

title: US Long Weekend Hacks: 9 Days Off With 4 Days of Leave
author: Local Expert
excerpt: Eleven federal holidays, four of them on a Monday or Friday. Here is how to turn the rest of the 2026 calendar into nine-day breaks with two to four days of leave.
content:
Federal holidays do the heavy lifting, but the us long weekend you actually get depends on where the dates land. The United States runs eleven federal holidays, and four of them fall on a Monday or a Friday in 2026. Those need no planning at all.

The rest are where the strategy starts. A holiday in the middle of the week is worth more than its single day, because one or two well-placed leave days can turn it into a nine-day break. Everything below uses the official 2026 us public holidays calendar.

The one rule behind every US long weekend

Count the workdays between a holiday and the nearest weekend. That gap is what you pay for with leave. A Monday holiday has a gap of zero. A Wednesday holiday has one workday on each side, so spending two leave days buys a five-day block.

The same maths works at year end, where Christmas and New Year sit one week apart and can be merged into a sixteen-day stretch.

2026 US long weekend calendar

Dates below are the observed federal dates. Leave needed counts only the days you have to book yourself.

Holiday2026 dateDayLeave neededTotal off
New Year's DayJan 1Thu1 (Fri)4 days
Martin Luther King Jr. DayJan 19Mon03 days
Presidents' DayFeb 16Mon03 days
Memorial DayMay 25Mon03 days
JuneteenthJun 19Fri03 days
Independence Day (observed)Jul 3Fri03 days
Labor DaySep 7Mon03 days
Columbus DayOct 12Mon03 days
Veterans DayNov 11Wed2 (Thu + Fri)5 days
ThanksgivingNov 26Thu1 (Fri)4 days
Christmas DayDec 25Fri4 (Mon to Thu)9 days
New Year's Day 2027Jan 1Fri4 (Mon to Thu)9 days

The three bridges worth using

The Wednesday bridge

Veterans Day lands on Wednesday, November 11. Book Thursday and Friday and the break runs from Wednesday through Sunday, five days for two leave days.

The weekend-edge bridge

New Year's Day 2026 fell on a Thursday, which made Friday, January 2 the cheapest leave day of the year. The same move works whenever a holiday sits at the edge of a weekend.

The end-of-year stretch

Christmas Day 2026 is a Friday and New Year's Day 2027 is a Friday. Book December 21 to 24 and December 28 to 31, and you are off from December 19 to January 3. Eight leave days buy sixteen consecutive days away, and most offices are half empty anyway.

Where state calendars change the answer

The federal list is only the floor for any american long weekend 2026 plan. Roughly half the states add their own days, and the extras vary more than people expect:

  • California observes Cesar Chavez Day on March 31.
  • Texas keeps Emancipation Day separate from the federal Juneteenth.
  • Massachusetts adds Patriots' Day on the third Monday of April.
  • Several states give the day after Thanksgiving as a holiday, which removes the need for leave entirely.

If your state adds a Monday or a Friday, that is a free long weekend you did not have to plan.

Making floating holidays pay off

Floating holidays are the most underused benefit in American time off. Because you choose the date, they can be spent on the bridge days above instead of on a fixed day everyone else takes. Two floating days placed on the Tuesday and Thursday around Veterans Day turn a single Wednesday holiday into nine days off.

This is the simplest way to maximize us holidays without negotiating anything. Ask your manager early, because the useful slots near holidays go first.

Frequently asked questions

Which 2026 US holidays create the best long weekends?

The free ones are every Monday and Friday holiday: MLK Day, Presidents' Day, Memorial Day, Juneteenth, Independence Day, Labor Day, and Columbus Day. The best paid upgrades are Veterans Day and Christmas, where a few leave days buy the largest blocks.

Can I negotiate more PTO?

Sometimes, and usually at the offer stage rather than later. Ask for a specific number and explain how you plan to use it. A request built around a booked trip is easier to approve than a general ask for flexibility.

What if my employer does not observe federal holidays?

Check your contract first. Private employers set their own calendars, and some trade fixed days for floating days you can place yourself. If the choice is offered, take the floating days.

Is unpaid leave worth it for a longer break?

Only when the trip is the point. Unpaid days cost real money and are harder to approve than PTO, so treat them as a last resort rather than a planning tool.

title: 美国长周末攻略：4 天年假换 9 天连休
author: 本地专家
excerpt: 一年 11 个联邦假日，其中 4 个落在周一或周五。本文讲清怎么用 2 到 4 天年假，把 2026 年其余的假日接成 9 天连休。
content:
美国长周末攻略：4 天年假换 9 天连休

联邦假日只是底线，一个 us long weekend 能休多久，真正取决于日期落在星期几。美国一年有 11 个联邦假日，2026 年里有 4 个正好落在周一或周五，这四天完全不用规划。

其余几个才是攻略的价值所在。周中的假日不止值一天：花一到两天年假，就能把它接成 9 天连休。下面的日期都按 2026 年官方日历。

一条规则，看穿所有美国长周末

数一数假日和最近周末之间隔了几个工作日，那就是你要用年假买的距离。假日落在周一，间隔是零。落在周三，两边各有一个工作日，各花一天就能换出 5 天连休。

同样的算法在年底最划算：圣诞节和元旦隔着一周，接起来能拼出 16 天。

2026 年美国长周末一览

日期为联邦观察日。「需请假」只算你自己要请的天数。

假日2026 日期星期需请假连休天数
元旦1 月 1 日四1（周五）4 天
马丁·路德·金日1 月 19 日一03 天
总统日2 月 16 日一03 天
阵亡将士纪念日5 月 25 日一03 天
六月节6 月 19 日五03 天
独立日（补休）7 月 3 日五03 天
劳工节9 月 7 日一03 天
哥伦布日10 月 12 日一03 天
退伍军人节11 月 11 日三2（周四 + 周五）5 天
感恩节11 月 26 日四1（周五）4 天
圣诞节12 月 25 日五4（周一至周四）9 天
2027 年元旦1 月 1 日五4（周一至周四）9 天

三种值得用的接法

周三接法

退伍军人节在 11 月 11 日周三。请周四和周五，从周三一直休到周日，两天年假换五天。

周末边缘接法

2026 年元旦是周四，1 月 2 日周五就是全年最便宜的一天年假。只要假日贴在周末边上，同样的做法都能用。

年底连休

2026 年圣诞是周五，2027 年元旦也是周五。请 12 月 21 到 24 日、12 月 28 到 31 日，就能从 12 月 19 日休到 1 月 3 日。8 天年假换 16 天连休，而且那两周办公室本来就没几个人。

州历会改变答案

联邦假日只是下限。在规划一个 american long weekend 2026 时，大约一半的州另有自己的假日，多出来的部分比很多人想的更多：

  • 加州在 3 月 31 日过塞萨尔·查韦斯日。
  • 德州的解放日与联邦的六月节分开计算。
  • 马萨诸塞州在 4 月第三个周一过爱国者日。
  • 部分州把感恩节后一天也定为假日，那样一天年假都不用请。

如果你的州多出一个周一或周五，那是一个不用规划就白拿的长周末。

把浮动假日用在对的地方

浮动假日是美国假期里最容易被浪费的一项。日期由你自己选，所以它可以用在上面的接法上，而不是跟着大家挤同一天。在退伍军人节前后的周二和周四各放一天浮动假，一个周三假日就变成了 9 天连休。

这是在不谈条件的情况下最大化美国假日的最好办法。记得早点跟主管报备，靠近假日的热门时段总是先到先得。

常见问题

2026 年哪些美国假日最容易接出长周末？

免费的包括所有落在周一或周五的假日：马丁·路德·金日、总统日、阵亡将士纪念日、六月节、独立日、劳工节和哥伦布日。最值得花年假的是退伍军人节和圣诞节，几天的年假能换出最大的连休块。

可以谈更多年假吗？

有时可以，而且通常在入职谈条件时比入职后更容易成功。提一个具体天数，并说明你打算怎么用。围绕一段已经订好的行程来谈，比笼统地说想要更灵活更容易被批准。

公司不放假怎么办？

先看合同。私企有自己的假日表，有些会把固定假日换成可以自己安排日期的浮动假日。如果能选，选浮动假日。

为了更长的假期，请无薪假值得吗？

只有当这趟行程本身就是目的时才值得。无薪假是真金白银的损失，也比年假更难开口，所以把它当最后手段，而不是规划工具。
